name: botmef-saas
description: botmef-saas — atención al cliente por WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API), multi-tenant

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --workspace apps/api run start:dev" "npm --workspace apps/web run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/api run lint:check && npm --workspace apps/web run lint
scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.db:seed: npm --workspace apps/api exec -- prisma db seed
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
